heading.en: Through-Fixing with a Bolt and Sleeve
heading.zh: 使用螺栓和套筒进行穿孔固定

body.en: Through-fixing with a bolt and sleeve allows installers to position a base plate or bracket first and drill straight through its clearance holes into concrete or masonry. Unlike a pre-set stud anchor that requires spotting holes before placing the fixture, a sleeve-type bolt anchor keeps alignment accurate on site. Common metric sizes range from M8 to M20, with an M12 bolt anchor widely used for medium-duty steel base plates, racking, and mechanical supports. Carbon steel anchors often follow ISO 898-1 property classes or DIN specifications, while stainless bolt anchors in A2 or A4 grades suit humid or coastal sites along routes through Durban, Beira, and Mombasa. Bolt anchor load capacity depends on concrete compressive strength, embedment depth, and edge distance, while expansion sleeves also perform differently from standard torque-controlled expansion bolts in cracked concrete or masonry. A typical industry value for effective embedment on an M12 anchor is around 60 mm to 80 mm, subject to engineering design. Follow this sequence: first, mark and drill through the base plate clearance holes using a carbide-tipped bit sized to the anchor; second, drill into the substrate at least 10 mm deeper than embedment to hold drilling dust; third, blow and brush out dust completely; fourth, tap the bolt and sleeve assembly through the plate into the hole; fifth, tighten the nut to the specified torque so the cone draws into the sleeve without stripping threads.
body.zh: 使用螺栓和套筒进行穿孔固定，可让施工人员先定位底板或支架，再直接穿过预留光孔钻入混凝土或砌体。与需要先放线定位再就位的预埋螺柱锚栓不同，套筒式螺栓锚栓能在现场保持孔位对准。常见公制规格为M8至M20，其中M12螺栓锚栓广泛用于中等载荷钢底板、货架和机械支架。碳钢锚栓通常符合ISO 898-1性能等级或DIN标准，而A2或A4不锈钢螺栓锚栓则适合经由德班、贝拉和蒙巴萨运输线抵达的潮湿或沿海工地。螺栓锚栓承载力取决于混凝土抗压强度、锚固深度和边距，同时膨胀套筒在开裂混凝土或砌体中的表现也与常规扭矩控制型膨胀螺栓不同。M12锚栓有效锚固深度的典型行业数值约为60毫米至80毫米，具体须以工程设计为准。安装步骤如下：第一，使用与锚栓匹配的硬质合金钻头穿过底板光孔定位并钻孔；第二，向基材钻孔，深度比锚固深度至少深10毫米以容纳钻粉；第三，彻底吹扫并刷净孔内粉尘；第四，将螺栓与套筒组件穿板敲入孔中；第五，按规定扭矩拧紧螺母，使圆锥体拉入套筒且不损坏螺纹。

body.en: Selecting the right diameter for bolt anchors on a base plate starts with structural shear and tension loads from the anchor supplier design calculation, rather than guessing from hole size alone. Common metric options include M10, M12, M16, and M20, with M12 bolt anchor sizes widely used for light-to-medium steel brackets and equipment frames. First, confirm the base plate thickness and clearance hole diameter per EN or ISO structural steel practice, keeping hole clearance tight enough to transfer shear without excessive slip. Next, check bolt anchor load capacity against concrete strength, edge distance, and anchor spacing so cone breakout or splitting does not govern. A typical industry value for minimum edge distance in uncracked concrete is five to seven times the nominal anchor diameter, though exact limits depend on product geometry and load type. When comparing a bolt anchor vs expansion bolt for vibrating machinery or dynamic base plates, wedge-style bolt anchors often provide higher torque consistency and deeper embedment than sleeve expansion bolts. Finally, choose carbon steel with zinc or hot-dip galvanizing for dry indoor sites, or stainless bolt anchor grades such as A4-70 or AISI 316 for coastal or humid industrial zones around Durban, Beira, or Mombasa where chlorides accelerate corrosion. Match anchor thread diameter, embedment depth, and washer dimensions to your base plate drawing before placing an order.
body.zh: 为基板选择锚栓直径，应从锚栓供应商的结构计算书出发，依据剪力和拉力载荷确定规格，而不是仅凭孔径估算。常见公制规格包括M10、M12、M16和M20，其中M12锚栓常用于轻中型钢支架与设备底座。首先，参照EN或ISO钢结构做法核对基板厚度与通孔直径，使孔隙足够紧凑以传递剪力并控制滑移。其次，对照混凝土强度、边距与锚栓间距核算锚栓承载力，避免发生混凝土锥体破坏或劈裂。在非开裂混凝土中，最小边距的一个典型行业值是公称锚栓直径的5到7倍，但具体限值取决于产品几何形状与受力类型。在对比锚栓与膨胀螺栓用于振动设备或动载基板时，楔式锚栓通常比套管式膨胀螺栓具有更稳定的扭矩控制和更深的锚入深度。最后，干燥室内工况可选用镀锌或热浸镀锌碳钢；而在德班、贝拉或蒙巴萨等沿海或高湿工业区，氯化物会加速腐蚀，应选用A4-70或AISI 316等不锈钢锚栓。下单前务必将锚栓螺纹直径、锚入深度与垫圈尺寸与基板图纸逐一核对。

body.en: Proper embedment depth and edge distance determine whether bolt anchors reach published load capacity or spall concrete. Unlike a typical expansion bolt that grips along a shallower zone, a heavy-duty wedge or drop-in bolt anchor transfers tension and shear deeper into concrete, though exact values depend on anchor design and manufacturer data under EN 1992-4, ACI 318, or ASTM E488. For a common M12 bolt anchor, typical industry values for effective embedment depth often sit around 70 mm to 100 mm, while minimum edge distance can range from 60 mm to 120 mm depending on concrete strength and edge reinforcement. Shallow embedment or tight edge spacing lowers pull-out and edge-breakout resistance under base plate shear loads. Follow these steps before setting anchors: first, check base plate hole layout, anchor spacing, and distance from free concrete edges against structural drawings; second, mark hole centers and drill perpendicular to the concrete surface using a carbide bit matched to anchor diameter and required depth; third, clean dust and debris from each hole with compressed air and a wire brush so expansion sleeves or wedges seat properly; fourth, insert the bolt anchor through the base plate to full embedment depth and tighten with a calibrated torque wrench to specified torque without over-torquing. In humid ports like Durban or Beira and across southern Africa, stainless bolt anchors in A4 or 316 grade help resist corrosion.
body.zh: 锚固深度与边距决定锚栓能否达到标称承载力或崩裂混凝土。与握裹区较浅的常规膨胀螺栓不同，重型膨胀锚栓可将拉力和剪力更深传入混凝土，但具体数值取决于锚栓设计与依据EN 1992-4、ACI 318或ASTM E488的制造商数据。以常见M12锚栓为例，有效锚固深度典型行业值通常为70至100毫米，最小边距视混凝土强度及配筋可在60至120毫米之间。锚固过浅或边距过小会降低基板剪力下的抗拔与边缘崩裂承载力。安装锚栓前请按以下步骤操作：第一，对照结构图纸核查基板孔位、锚栓间距及边缘距离；第二，标出孔位中心，按锚栓直径与深度配硬质合金钻头垂直混凝土表面钻孔；第三，用压缩空气和钢丝刷清除孔内粉尘碎屑，使套管或楔块正确就位；第四，穿基板插至完整锚固深度，用校准扭矩扳手按规定扭矩紧固防过紧。在德班、贝拉等港口及南部非洲，A4或316级不锈钢锚栓有助于抗腐蚀。

heading.en: Finishes for Outdoor and Coastal Sites
heading.zh: 户外与沿海工地表面处理

body.en: Selecting the right finish for bolt anchors prevents premature rust and loss of bolt anchor load capacity in exposed outdoor or marine air. Standard thin electro-zinc plating under ISO 4042 suits dry indoor work, whereas outdoor structural steel, base plate mounts, and expansion bolt assemblies require heavier protection. For general outdoor exposure, hot-dip galvanizing per ISO 1461 or ASTM A153 builds a thick zinc-iron coating, with 50 microns as a typical industry value for small threaded parts. Along salt-spray coastlines and ports such as Durban or Beira, stainless steel bolt anchor options in A4 or 316 grade resist chloride pitting far better than A2 or 304, though matching nut and washer grades prevents galling. Follow this step-by-step selection routine when ordering from a bolt anchor supplier: first, check site exposure, moisture cycles, and service life; second, choose the base finish or stainless alloy, such as an M12 bolt anchor in A4 stainless for coastal brackets or hot-dip galvanized carbon steel for inland base plate frames; third, verify internal and external thread fit after galvanizing so nuts run freely without forcing; fourth, confirm whether a bolt anchor or a heavy-duty expansion bolt matches the cracked or uncracked concrete rating; fifth, pack cartons with moisture barriers and desiccant for sea transit across Africa. Always avoid mixing dissimilar metals in wet zones where galvanic corrosion accelerates attack on the less noble metal.
body.zh: 为锚栓选择正确的表面处理，可在暴露的户外或海洋空气中防止过早生锈并避免锚栓承载力下降。符合ISO 4042标准的常规薄层电镀锌适用于干燥室内作业，而户外钢结构、底板安装以及膨胀螺栓组件则需要更强的防护。对于一般户外环境，符合ISO 1461或ASTM A153标准的热浸镀锌可形成较厚的锌铁合金层，小型螺纹件的典型行业值为50微米。在德班或贝拉等高盐雾海岸线与港口一带，A4或316级不锈钢锚栓的抗氯化物点蚀能力远优于A2或304，但螺母与垫圈材质需匹配以防咬死。向锚栓供应商下单时，请按以下步骤选型：第一步，核查工地暴露等级、干湿循环与设计寿命；第二步，选定基础涂层或不锈钢牌号，例如沿海支架选用A4级M12锚栓，内陆底板框架选用热浸镀锌碳钢；第三步，检查镀锌后内外螺纹配合，确保螺母顺畅旋合不强行拧紧；第四步，确认锚栓或重型膨胀螺栓是否符合开裂或非开裂混凝土评级；第五步，在跨非洲海运中使用防潮包装与干燥剂。在潮湿区域切勿混用异种金属，以免电偶腐蚀加速较活泼金属的锈蚀。

body.en: Installing post-installed bolt anchors or expansion bolts for a base plate requires disciplined execution so load capacity matches design assumptions under EN 1992-4, ASTM E488, or ISO standards. First, verify base concrete strength, curing age, edge distances, and spacing, and locate rebar to avoid hitting steel. Second, drill perpendicular to the concrete using a carbide bit matching the anchor diameter and embedment depth. Third, clean the borehole thoroughly with oil-free compressed air, a wire brush, and air again; dust left in the hole lowers pullout resistance. Fourth, position the base plate, insert the anchor to full embedment, and seat the expansion clip or sleeve with a hammer if required. Fifth, tighten the nut using a calibrated torque wrench to the manufacturer specification rather than guessing by feel or over-torquing with an impact wrench. For an M12 carbon steel bolt anchor or expansion bolt, a typical industry value for installation torque sits around 60 to 85 Nm depending on steel grade, thread friction, and whether hot-dip galvanizing or stainless steel is used. Stainless steel anchors in coastal zones such as Durban or Beira require care against thread galling, so apply an approved anti-seize or lubricant only when permitted by the anchor datasheet. Finally, re-check torque after initial settling on critical base plate connections and always follow the specific anchor manufacturer instructions.
body.zh: 在底板上安装后置锚栓或膨胀螺栓需要规范操作，以确保承载力符合EN 1992-4、ASTM E488或ISO标准的设计假设。第一步，核实混凝土基体强度、养护龄期、边距与间距，并探测钢筋位置以避开钢筋。第二步，使用与锚栓直径和锚固深度匹配的硬质合金钻头垂直钻孔。第三步，用无油压缩空气、钢丝刷和再次吹气彻底清孔；孔内残留粉尘会降低抗拔承载力。第四步，就位底板，将锚栓插至规定锚固深度，并在需要时用锤具敲击使膨胀夹片或套管就位。第五步，使用经校准的扭矩扳手按制造商规定值拧紧螺母，切勿凭手感估算或用冲击扳手过度拧紧。对于M12碳钢锚栓或膨胀螺栓，安装扭矩的典型行业值约为60至85牛米，具体取决于钢材等级、螺纹摩擦系数以及是否采用热浸镀锌或不锈钢材质。在德班或贝拉等沿海地区使用不锈钢锚栓时需注意防止螺纹咬死，仅在锚栓技术手册允许的情况下涂抹认可的防咬死剂或润滑剂。最后，在关键底板连接初期沉降后复查扭矩，并始终遵循具体锚栓制造商的安装说明。

body.en: Evaluating bolt anchor load capacity requires matching anchor geometry, concrete strength, and safety factors to structural loads rather than relying only on catalog pullout numbers. First, confirm the base material grade and edge or spacing distances, since cracked concrete under EN 1992-4 or ACI 318 reduces holding values compared with uncracked concrete. Second, distinguish a heavy-duty bolt anchor from a standard sleeve expansion bolt when selecting a bolt anchor for base plate installations carrying shear and dynamic vibration. Third, check thread size and embedment depth on common sizes such as an M12 bolt anchor or M16 anchor, verifying steel tensile and shear strength under ISO 898-1 or ASTM A307 and comparing carbon steel against A4 stainless bolt anchor options for coastal humidity near Durban or Beira. Fourth, apply an appropriate safety factor to characteristic failure loads; a typical industry value for working load limits on structural anchors ranges from one-third to one-fourth of ultimate tension or shear capacity, adjusted for partial safety factors and installation reliability. Fifth, verify hole diameter, cleaning steps, and torque wrench settings during trial pulls at the site before releasing bulk orders from a bolt anchor supplier. When shipping to inland markets such as Zimbabwe, check corrosion protection and dry export packing so threads and expansion sleeves arrive ready for accurate installation torque without surface pitting.
body.zh: 评估锚栓承载力需要将锚栓几何尺寸、混凝土强度和安全系数与结构荷载相匹配，而不能仅依赖目录拉拔数据。首先，确认基材等级与边距或间距，因为依据EN 1992-4或ACI 318的开裂混凝土相比未开裂混凝土会降低锚固承载力。其次，在为承受剪切和动荷载的底板安装选用螺栓锚栓时，应区分重型锚栓与普通膨胀螺栓。第三，检查M12或M16锚栓等常见规格的螺纹尺寸与埋深，依据ISO 898-1或ASTM A307核实钢材抗拉与抗剪强度，并在德班或贝拉等沿海高湿环境下对比碳钢与A4不锈钢锚栓方案。第四，对特征破坏荷载施加安全系数；结构锚栓工作荷载的典型行业值为极限抗拉或抗剪承载力的三分之一至四分之一，并结合分项安全系数与安装可靠性调整。第五，在向锚栓供应商下达大货订单前，于现场试拉期间核实钻孔直径、清孔步骤和扭矩扳手设定值。向津巴布韦等内陆市场发货时，检查防腐与干燥出口包装，使螺纹和膨胀套筒运抵后无点蚀，可直接按扭矩施工。

body.en: Proper packing protects bolt anchors and expansion bolts from moisture and impact during ocean transit and inland haulage across southern and eastern Africa. Start by sorting hardware by diameter, length, and material grade, such as M10, M12, and M16 carbon steel or stainless steel conforming to ISO 898-1 or ASTM A193 standards. Pack each size in heavy-duty inner cartons or woven bags with clear batch labels showing dimensions, thread pitch, and base plate anchor specifications. A typical industry value for inner box weight is 15 to 25 kg to prevent handling strain at job sites. Next, palletize cartons on fumigated timber or ISPM 15 compliant pallets, wrapping loads in stretch film and securing corners with edge protectors and strapping. For shipments destined for Zimbabwe or Zambia via Beira or Durban, account for port dwell times, customs clearance, and long road corridors where vibration and coastal humidity test packaging integrity. Use vapor corrosion inhibitor liners for carbon steel bolt anchors when sea transit passes humid zones, while stainless bolt anchors still require clean separation to avoid surface scratching. Finally, confirm container load plans, gross weight limits, and port arrival windows with your bolt anchor supplier before dispatch so crane unloading and site delivery match your installation schedule. Check load capacity ratings and embedment depth notes on packing lists so site engineers verify anchor suitability quickly upon arrival.
body.zh: 规范包装可保护锚栓与膨胀螺栓在南部及东部非洲海运和陆运中免受潮气与撞击。首先按直径、长度和材质等级分类，例如符合ISO 898-1或ASTM A193标准的M10、M12及M16碳钢或不锈钢件。将各规格装入加厚内箱或编织袋，贴上清晰批次标签，标明尺寸、牙距与底板锚固参数。内箱重量的常见行业值为15至25公斤，便于工地搬运，并减少人工搬运疲劳。随后将纸箱码放于熏蒸木托盘或ISPM 15托盘与海事运输规范要求相符的底座上，用缠绕膜包裹并以护角和打包带紧固。发往津巴布韦或赞比亚并经贝拉或德班中转的货物，须兼顾港口滞留、清关及长途公路振动与沿海高湿对包装的影响。碳钢锚栓经潮湿航段宜配气相防锈内衬，不锈钢锚栓也需隔离防划伤。最后，发货前与锚栓供应商核对集装箱配载、毛重上限与到港窗口，确保吊卸及交付贴合施工计划，并在装箱单列明承载力与锚入深度便于现场核查。
